# Job metadata upgrade fixture

`job-metadata-format15.db` was generated by JobDB `554937b77c2b20145b61e100e28e626315a1eac7` before installing the new tables. It contains an installed `c2` project, registered cell, ordinary application metadata, a ready job with an open goal, and a completed retained job with two history chapters and a succeeded goal. The fixture has SHA-256 `42743191daaa0dc5122c7c29d59928656fcc47832b0f233a25e3a2d2e78bbd34`.

To regenerate the same semantic fixture (storage-generated IDs vary), place `job_metadata_seed_test.go` in `pkg/jobdb/runtime/sqlite/` in a detached checkout at that commit, and run from that checkout with an absent destination:

```sh
GOWORK=off GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly JOBDB_METADATA_FIXTURE_PATH=/tmp/jobdb-metadata-format15.db \
  go test -count=1 -v ./pkg/jobdb/runtime/sqlite -run '^TestSeedJobMetadataUpgradeFromMain$'
```
